mechanism: Naloxone may precipitate acute withdrawal in opioid-dependent patients on MAOIs, and isocarboxazid can potentiate sympathomimetic effects if naloxone is used in opioid overdose scenarios with concurrent noradrenergic activity.
action: Use naloxone cautiously in patients taking MAOIs; monitor closely for hypertensive crisis and withdrawal symptoms; consider alternative reversal agents or dose adjustment if possible.
